feeds.title: Nude & Happy
feeds.description: Nude and Happy is a website exclusively dedicated to naturism, a unique art of living, promoting self-respect, respect to others and respect to the environment.

feeds.title: Naked Wanderings Blog
feeds.description: We are Nick and Lins, a bit of a crazy (in a healthy way) 30 -something naturist couple who full time travel around the world in search of the best places to get naked and to learn more about naturism and nudism. On this blog, you can find lots of information about naturism, nudism, and clothing-optional destinations around the world.

feeds.title: The Free Range Naturist
feeds.description: Each week, through enjoyable (OR acclaimed) stories and pictures, I will show you with delightful highlights, the very practical skills that I have used to accomplish body freedom here in the Southwest. I'll post short informational essays about naturism, like health, mental health, or spirituality.

feeds.title: Naturistplace Blog
feeds.description: Let's normalize nudity.. Naturistplace has been online since 1996. But our latest blog is brand new. It's regularly updated with news and original opinion on all aspects of naturism.

feeds.title: Irish Naturist Association Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1963, the INA is dedicated to promoting and expanding naturism in Ireland. We are a non profit organisation.

feeds.title: Everyday Nudist
feeds.description: A Blog on Nudism and Life. I started this blog at the encouragement of my wife as a place where I can talk about not only nudist things but life topics in general. Some blogs are fun, some are serious, and for many, uncomfortable topics that you wouldn't talk about at the dinner table. So whether you are an everyday nudist, occasional nudist, or no way in hell I will ever be a nudist, there is something for everyone.

feeds.title: The Naturist Society Foundation
feeds.description: The Naturist Society Foundation celebrates the nude human form as inherently wholesome and natural. The foundation promotes body acceptance through clothing-optional recreation using the tools of education and community outreach.

feeds.title: Aching for Eden Blog
feeds.description: We are a Christian naturist couple with a blog about journey.You will find detailed accounts on this blog of our theoretical knowledge (studies) and practical applications (experience) that have changed the entire way we live for the better. We bare our souls as we eagerly strive to reclaim the innocence of Eden in our everyday lives.

feeds.title: NudeChrissy Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to 'NudeChrissy' I prefer 'naked'. Whenever the opportunity arises, I take all my clothes off. My name is 'Chris'. I love traveling and so I go on holiday several times a year. But I spend my holidays only as nudist holidays.

feeds.title: Bare Oaks Blog
feeds.description: News, updates, and information about Bare Oaks Family Naturist Park as well as general topics about naturism. Bare Oaks is a year-round naturist park where the entire family can experience traditional naturist values in a modern setting. Naturism is more than just taking your clothes off. It is a life philosophy with physical and psychological benefits.

feeds.title: My Blog about nudism and naturism (not porn)
feeds.description: A blog about nudism and naturism. Nudism is a wonderful lifestyle and there are many good reasons to practice it. It needs to be something popular.

feeds.title: Flying Naturist Blog
feeds.description: I'm Nick and am known as the Flying Naturist. I have made this website to be able to write about my naturist lifestyle. I intend to blog on here as well as share my pictures and videos of my naturist life including going to events like swimming, bowling, holidays, walks, etc.

feeds.title: The Nude ger Blog
feeds.description: Living in a quiet, coastal town on the northern rivers of New South Wales, Australia, with my partner and Great Dane, Soldier, I am a naked yoga teacher, a nudist, a body positive advocate and the creatress of The Nude Blogger.

feeds.title: ReNude Pride
feeds.description: Roger Poladopoulos began this online journal as a tool for sharing his experiences of living clothes-free and proud in today's modern world.The purpose in publishing on ReNude Pride is to encourage, promote and support bare living not only within the gay community but throughout our broader society as well.

feeds.title: INF-FNI International Naturist Federation
feeds.description: The International Naturist Federation (INF-FNI) is an organisation consisting of member federations, correspondents and extraordinary members in over forty countries. Together with other interested parties involved in naturist activities, the INF-FNI works to enhance and improve the naturist experience and the naturist business climate by promoting the benefits of naturism to the general public.

feeds.title: True Nudists Blog
feeds.description: The True Nudists blog discusses issues and topics that are relevant to the nudist community. Social networking for nudists. That was the thought when True Nudists was launched in 2007. The site was created as a way to tap into a younger generation and attract a whole new generation to nudism.

feeds.title: Nude Alexis
feeds.description: My approach is simple...promote nudism, write about nudism, share our stories, the changes we've made, the better people we've become, and how we can incorporate nudism into our everyday lives. We should not be looked at by society as some fetish crowd looking for a thrill, but as normal people choosing to live a life that gives us a fulfillment that no on else can achieve.
